description: The classic ALEX-Suite workflow, as a linear ChiSurf pipeline: files, µs-ALEX alternation, burst search, background, accurate FRET, E-S. Plus the titration/stack-plot analysis; the old ALEX-Suite CSV export is the converter command (csc alex-suite export-legacy), not a pipeline step. Writes the same .pto container and burst companions as the PIE burst workflow.

accepts.name: photons
accepts.summary: The ALEX measurements: photon streams of the Datasets workspace (the Files step); the burst runs found become their children.

accepts.name: setup
accepts.summary: A detector/channel setup of the Datasets workspace, loaded into the Setup step.

accepts.name: titration
accepts.summary: Titration points: burst runs of the Datasets workspace, one per concentration.
